ground_truth.node_text: Fit a sealed test arbor with a coolant pressure gauge and flow indicator into the spindle taper. Start the coolant through spindle circuit at the normal operating pressure. Observe the flow indicator for steady flow; pulsing or absent flow indicates a blocked spindle check valve or a failing coolant pump.
